ns2:course.label: Career Dev & Indiv with Disab
ns2:course.description: Course focuses on career development and employment of individuals with disabilities. Emphasis will be placed on determining job options, job development, self-determination and person-centered planning. 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. Prerequisite: Admission to the Department of Special Education, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. Prerequisite: Admission to the Department of Special Education, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Course will meet during the first eight weeks only.
